look: Stylised 3D still in exactly the designer art-toy style of the reference pictures (vinyl-and-felt figures, matte skin, hair as one solid sculpted shape, real fabric clothes with a coarse soft weave), set in a sunny hand-built model town: painted houses in cream, terracotta, mint and sky blue, cobbled streets, plain cream bunting, lemon trees in terracotta pots. Low golden late-afternoon sun coming from the LEFT, long warm violet shadows. The characters are exactly those of the reference pictures, unchanged: TIMO (tall and thin, black flat-top, dark brown skin, teal track jacket with a cream sleeve stripe, navy trousers, tiny teal backpack, big yellow watch on his left wrist, teal-and-coral scarf knotted short at the throat), LUNA (short, coral bob with a full fringe, freckles, coral football shirt with a cream collar, light-blue denim shorts, cream socks, chunky cream trainers, her own scarf, plain teal in two soft teal tones with no coral on it, hanging long), BIG YELLOW (the giant sunflower-yellow hard-shell suitcase with dark-violet wheels and one short fixed handle; standing upright its flat top reaches Luna's chest) and the fat ginger CAT with the cream belly and half-closed eyes. Vertical 9:16 film frame, eye-level camera, 28mm lens, soft background. No letters, numbers, signs, logos or clock faces anywhere.
film: Stylised 3D animation of designer art-toy figures in a sunny hand-built model town; they move and act like living people, with expressive eyebrows and mouths; slightly snappy, never floaty. Golden late-afternoon light from the left. A friend seems to hold the camera: a tiny natural wobble. No music. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no letters.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: reproduce the FIRST reference picture exactly: the same hilltop street, light, framing and the same poses (Timo on the right proudly holding up the top of a long paper strip that runs down to a roll lying on the cobbles at his feet; Luna on the left with her phone, beside Big Yellow). Change ONLY the paper: The paper is clearly a hand-drawn PLAN: cream paper covered with a thin blue grid, one long red route line running along it, and many little drawn pictures along the line (a football, an aeroplane, a bed, a train, a stadium). There is no writing, no letters and no numbers on it. The roll on the ground is a thick solid roll of the same plan paper, about knee-high, with the grid visible on its outside; it has no cardboard tube. Timo looks at Luna with a proud smile, mouth closed; Luna looks at the paper with one eyebrow raised. Only Timo, Luna, the suitcase and the paper: no cat.
shots.video: @Timo, proud, lifts the top of the plan paper a little higher, looks into the camera and says, in a lively acted voice: "My plan. Forty metres long." While he speaks, the thick roll of plan paper at his feet starts to roll by itself: it rolls forward along the cobbles, towards the camera, faster and faster, and out of the bottom of the frame, unrolling, so the strip of plan paper now runs from his hands along the ground and out of the bottom of the frame. He does not notice. @Luna watches the roll go, both eyebrows rising. One continuous shot: the camera does not cut and does not move. Nobody else appears. Sound: his voice, paper unrolling, the roll bumping over cobbles.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: the same low wall and street as the FIRST reference picture, golden sun from the LEFT. The fat ginger CAT sits on top of the wall in the upper half of the frame, facing us, eyes half closed. In the lower half, on the cobbled street in front of the wall, a thick solid roll of plan paper, about knee-high, is rolling from right to left, blurred by its speed, and a long strip of the same paper lies flat on the cobbles behind it, running off the right edge of the frame. The paper is clearly a hand-drawn PLAN: cream paper covered with a thin blue grid, one long red route line running along it, and many little drawn pictures along the line (a football, an aeroplane, a bed, a train, a stadium). There is no writing, no letters and no numbers on it. It is a rolled-up plan, like an architect's drawing, with no cardboard tube: it must NOT look like toilet paper or kitchen paper. Only the cat and the roll of plan paper: no people.
shots.video: The thick roll of plan paper rolls fast across the street from right to left, unrolling its strip behind it, and leaves the frame on the left within one second; the long strip of plan paper stays lying on the cobbles. The cat on the wall follows the roll with its head, its eyes going wide. Then the cat hops down from the wall onto the street and trots after the roll, out of the frame on the left. One continuous shot: the camera does not cut and does not move. Nobody else appears. Sound: paper unrolling fast, the roll bumping over cobbles, one small cat meow.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: the same hilltop street, the same houses, the same warm low sun and the stadium far behind as the FIRST reference picture. LUNA alone, from the waist up, facing the CAMERA and looking straight into the lens with a sly friendly smile, mouth closed. She holds her phone in both hands in front of her chest with its BACK toward the camera (a plain coral case, no logo; the screen is not visible), both thumbs on it. Coral bob, coral football shirt, long plain teal scarf. Her head is in the MIDDLE of the frame; the upper third of the frame is only soft sky and rooftops. Only Luna: no Timo, no suitcase, no cat, no paper.
shots.video: @Luna looks straight into the camera, raises one eyebrow and says, sly, warm and lively: "One sentence." Then she looks down and types fast with both thumbs for about a second and a half, taps once, looks back up into the camera with a big grin and says, bright: "Done." The screen of the phone is never seen. One continuous shot: the camera does not cut and does not move. Nobody else appears. Sound: her voice, soft thumb taps.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: reproduce the FIRST reference picture: the same hilltop street, light and framing, LUNA on the left beside Big Yellow, TIMO on the right. Change ONLY this: the roll on the ground is GONE. The long strip of plan paper now runs from Timo's two hands down to the cobbles and then flat along the ground straight towards the camera and out of the bottom edge of the picture. The paper is a hand-drawn PLAN: cream paper with a thin blue grid, one long red route line and little drawn pictures along it (a football, an aeroplane, a bed, a train, a stadium); no writing, no letters, no numbers. TIMO faces the camera and stares straight into the lens, stunned: eyes wide open, mouth a small flat line, still holding the top end of the paper in both hands at chest height. LUNA shades her eyes with one hand and looks past the camera into the far distance behind us with an amused little smile, mouth closed; her other hand rests on Big Yellow. Timo's tiny teal backpack straps show on his shoulders, his teal-and-coral scarf, his yellow watch on his left wrist; Luna's long scarf is plain teal. Only Luna, Timo, the suitcase and the paper: no cat.
shots.video: The strip of plan paper in @Timo's hands is tugged from far away: it twitches and slides forward a little along the cobbles, again and again. @Timo does not move: he stares straight into the camera, stunned, without a word, and blinks once, slowly. @Luna, shading her eyes and looking past the camera into the distance, says exactly these five words, amused and warm, in a lively acted voice, and nothing else: "The cat has your plan." Then she lowers her hand and smiles at the camera. One continuous shot: the camera does not cut and does not move. Nobody else appears. Sound: her voice, paper rustling.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: reproduce the FIRST reference picture exactly (the same young woman, the same street, the same light, pose, phone and clothes) but CLOSER: she is framed from the chest up. Her head is in the middle of the frame; the upper third of the frame is only soft sky and rooftops; her two hands holding the phone (its BACK with the plain coral case toward the camera, both thumbs on it; the screen is not visible) are in the lower quarter of the frame. She looks straight into the lens with a sly friendly smile, mouth closed. Her scarf is ONE plain teal colour all the way round her neck and down the front: there is no coral, no pink and no stripe anywhere on the scarf. Only Luna: no Timo, no suitcase, no cat, no paper.
shots.video: @Luna looks straight into the camera, raises one eyebrow and says, sly, warm and lively: "One sentence." Then she looks down and types fast with both thumbs for about a second and a half, taps once, looks back up into the camera with a big grin and says, bright: "Done." Her scarf stays ONE plain teal colour all the way round her neck for the whole shot: no coral, no pink, no stripes on the scarf. The screen of the phone is never seen. One continuous shot: the camera does not cut, does not move and does not zoom; the framing never changes. Nobody else appears. Sound: her voice, soft thumb taps.
